input.rationale: Section 12 is materially one-sided and fails the fallback. TrueLink's indemnity (12(b), p0073/p0075) is limited to its own breach of the Agreement or failure to perform, with no third-party intellectual-property infringement indemnity anywhere in the document (the only infringement references are Client-side warranties in 8e and the domain-name search obligation in 2h), and no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies. By contrast Client's indemnity (12(a)) is open-ended, covering Client breach, System Agreement/Credit Repository defaults, the Web Site and Client Content without knowledge qualification, and product/service injury. We therefore target the preferred position: an express TrueLink duty to defend and indemnify Client and its affiliates for third-party IP, breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct claims with notice, defence control and cooperation, and Client's indemnity narrowed to Client Content and Client's breach of law. We would accept the fallback (IP-only indemnity with customary exclusions, remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap) if TrueLink resists.

proposal.summary: Add TrueLink defence/indemnity for third-party IP, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct with notice/control/cooperation procedure; narrow Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's breach of law.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity covers only its own breach of this Agreement and omits third-party IP infringement, while Client's indemnity is open-ended. We add a TrueLink duty to defend and indemnify Client and its affiliates for IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with a standard notice, control and cooperation procedure, and narrow Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's breach of law. As a fallback we can accept an IP-only indemnity with customary exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies subject to a 3x annual fees super-cap.

ops.text: c. TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates from and against all third-party claims, actions, expenses, losses and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to (i) any allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any related software or deliverable infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right, (ii) any breach by TrueLink of applicable law, (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content, Credit Data or other data of or provided by Client caused by TrueLink, or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party written notice of any claim for which indemnity is sought, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement of such claim, and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.
